scientific_objective: Resolve Turn 107 vs Turn 109 PDAS checkpoint discrepancy and establish rigorous solver parity

root_cause_summary.starting_state_finding: Turn 109 Step 3 initialized from raw State 0 (d_mapped, d_max=0.5193), NOT from equilibrated State 1 (d_equil, d_max=0.6550). Zero damage healing occurred.
root_cause_summary.tolerance_finding: Turn 109's release tolerance tol_res = 1e-6 was coarser than the initial mapped gradient residual (||grad||_inf = 8.764e-7), artificially clamping 2,752 nodes (99.4% of mesh).
root_cause_summary.physical_equivalence_finding: When evaluated on the identical State 1 checkpoint, L-BFGS-B and PDAS are 100% stationary fixed points (discrepancy < 1e-7, zero healing, zero KKT violations).
root_cause_summary.coupled_relaxation_finding: When PDAS uses physically scaled tolerance (1e-8) or natural unconstrained initialization, it tracks the full relaxation curve to RF2 = 180.24 N and d_max = 0.655, matching Turn 107 to -0.25%.

blocking_architectural_defects: Abaqus Standard static step ignores *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=DISPLACEMENT; displacement transfer cannot be enforced without boundary conditions.
f42_mixed_uel.for re-zeroes /CB_STATE_TRANS/ in UEXTERNALDB at LOP=0, precluding multi-job state chaining without persistent disk state.
SVARS(9..12) ingested into SV_H_COMMITTED only at KSTEP=1 and KINC<=1; multi-step restart into KSTEP>=2 drops all history.
Frozen production UEL does not implement element-level PDAS active-set projection; runtime bound enforcement requires external driver orchestration.
